criterion: Approval execution uses an atomic pending-to-executing compare-and-swap claim, idempotent external writes keyed by approval id, and stale-executing recovery so one approval cannot create duplicate external jobs.
evidence: src/sessions/store.ts claimApproval() single conditional UPDATE; recoverStaleApproval(); migration 3 claimed_at. Tests: concurrent approvals -> 1 job; CAS; stale recovery (security.test.ts).

criterion: Approval execution re-validates session, current mode/permission, tool-call binding, and argument digest before claiming; adapter verifies an HMAC-signed token for exactly harness.create_job.
evidence: src/tools/orchestrator.ts executeApproval re-checks session/binding/digest/validateArgs/permission; permissions.ts sign/verifyApprovalToken; harness_stub.ts assertApproval. Tests: mode-change reject, digest mismatch, ghost tool, signed-vs-forged (security/approval_token.test.ts).

criterion: Idempotency is a transactional state machine with a unique scoped key, request-hash binding that rejects key reuse with different content, and stale/failed adoption.

evidence: src/sessions/store.ts getRecentTurns filters by session_id AND mode; turns store mode; changeModeAtomic transaction. context_builder.ts mode-scoped key. Test: personal/business history isolation (captures outbound ModelRequest).

criterion: Multi-row state transitions are transactional with explicit lifecycle states, constraints, and recovery rules.
evidence: src/sessions/store.ts createPendingApprovalAtomic() one transaction; transaction() rollback; schema CHECK/FK/unique constraints. Tests: rollback on error; atomic pending approval (security.test.ts).
